test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What was the theme of the IIAS-DARPG India Conference held in New Delhi in February 2025?

options.text: Digital Transformation in Governance – Empowering Citizens and Reaching the Last Mile
Next Generation Administrative Reforms – Empowering Citizens and Reaching the Last Mile

solution:
The correct answer is __**Next Generation Administrative Reforms – Empowering Citizens and Reaching the Last Mile**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme of the **IIAS-DARPG India Conference** held in **New Delhi** in **February 2025** was **"Next Generation Administrative Reforms – Empowering Citizens and Reaching the Last Mile."**
 
• The conference was focused on discussing and strategizing over innovative administrative reforms aimed at improving governance and citizen empowerment.
 
• The phrase **"Next Generation Administrative Reforms"** refers to reforms that leverage technology, innovative practices, and robust policies to create a transparent, efficient, and citizen-centric governance framework.
 
• The focus of the conference was on **"Reaching the Last Mile,"** which emphasizes delivering services and benefits to the most marginalized and underserved sections of society.
 
• It addressed critical areas such as **digital governance, administrative efficiency, policy-making innovations, and citizen participation** in governance processes.
 
• The conference was jointly organized by the **Indian Institute of Advanced Study (IIAS)** and the **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India Conference by IIAS-DARPG:**

 
 
• The conference is an annual event that brings together policymakers, administrators, and experts to discuss and deliberate on critical administrative and governance reforms in **India.**
 
• The conference serves as a platform to exchange knowledge, share best practices, and identify innovative solutions to improve public service delivery and governance mechanisms.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Administrative Reforms:**
 
 
• Administrative reforms are crucial for enhancing **efficiency, transparency, and accountability** in governance and ensuring that government services reach all citizens equitably.
 
• They focus on improving decision-making processes, reducing bureaucratic red tape, and adopting technological solutions to streamline governance.
 
 
 
• **Empowering Citizens and Reaching the Last Mile:**
 
 
• This theme aligns with the Indian government’s commitment to ensuring that the benefits of governance reach even the most remote and marginalized communities.
 
• It emphasizes the use of **digital technologies and grassroots-level governance** to bridge the gap between the government and citizens.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Digital Transformation in Governance:**

 
 
• While digital transformation is a key enabler of governance reforms, the 2025 conference primarily revolved around the broader theme of next-generation administrative reforms.
 
• It included discussions on the integration of **AI, big data, and other technological advancements** to create a more inclusive governance ecosystem.
 
 
 
• **Strengthening Federal Structures:**
 
 
• Although strengthening federal structures is a critical aspect of governance, it was not the primary theme of the 2025 conference.
 
• Federalism is often discussed in the context of ensuring equitable distribution of resources and power between the central and state governments.
